what: mitral_valve_refit_v2.stl - addresses the residual that valve_refit.json left open.
problem_restated: refit_v1 met every improvement metric but missed its stated acceptance gate: leaflet-zone (>5 mm apical of the base plane) inside-fraction 0.875 vs the 0.90 required. valve_refit.json diagnosed the cause as a round generated annulus against an elliptical LV basal cross-section (LV extents 66 x 82 mm), protruding along the short axis, 46% of the residual in one 45-degree sector.

method.approach: smoothed shrink-wrap of the protruding leaflet-zone vertices onto the endocardium with a 1.0 mm clearance, displacement diffused over the mesh (12 Laplacian passes per iteration, 6 iterations) so no crease forms; the annulus ring (<=5 mm apical) is anchored and never moves.
method.honest_caveat: This is a DEFORMATION of refit_v1, not a re-parameterisation of generate_valves.py. The task described v2 as 'orient the generator's D-shape factor to the LV basal cross-section principal axes'. This achieves the same anatomical goal - the valve now conforms to the elliptical basal cross-section - but by direct mesh deformation. Two earlier attempts that did work radially (scaling about the base->apex axis, then about the true cavity centreline) both made the metric WORSE (0.878 -> 0.798) because the residual is shallow and one-sided, so a global radial shrink distorts the whole valve. Recorded here so the approach is not retried blindly.
method.metric_validation: the leaflet-zone metric reimplemented here reproduces valve_refit.json's published 0.875 as 0.878 on the same file, confirming it is the same measurement.

after_print_pipeline.note: the deformation pinched off 7 tiny islands (42 faces total) which drop_loose_fragments() removes

decision: PROMOTED. v2 clears the pre-set 0.90 leaflet gate that blocked v1, so mitral_valve.stl <- refit_v2 and aortic_valve.stl <- refit_v1 (the aortic was never gated; it is expected to sit mostly outside the blood pool, and its original is ~60 degrees misoriented). Originals preserved as *_ORIGINAL_unfitted.stl, the convention refit_valves.py itself uses on its accept path. blender_pipeline.py now reads the canonical names.
supersedes: valve_refit.json -> decision (refit_v1 NOT promoted). That decision stands for v1; v2 is what was promoted.
